title: 7A The Word on the Street — Слова и тренды

items.example: As each decade comes along, new words come into use.
In that decade, computer words were coming thick and fast.
The term snail mail spelled out how slow traditional mail seemed.
The word website neatly sums up that decade.
In that decade, social media really took off.
The word tweet came to define a new way of communicating.

items.phrase: rise to the height of fashion
items.example: Trends rise to the height of fashion and then fade.
After a period of being popular, words become unfashionable.
After a while, old words start to look attractive again.
Researchers tracked the use of words on an almost yearly basis.
Words come back in much the same way as clothes.
Old styles come back into fashion after some years.
We are all familiar with the idea of fashion cycles.
The team used a database to track the use of words.
Rare words start to look more unusual and attractive.
So people start to choose them again for their posts.
The phrase dress-down Friday captured a relaxed attitude to work.
